idle-walk-attempt1 EXACT PROMPT:
Create a NEW fully transparent RGBA hand-painted 2D isometric game animation atlas of ONLY the one white many-eyed organic watcher in the attached existing project artwork. EXACT IDENTITY: an ivory/white tapered floating organic mantle body, broad crown and flowing lower body, many curling pale lavender-white fleshy tendrils with SMALL gold-rimmed purple eyes embedded along them, one distinctive large VERTICAL PINK/MAGENTA central front eye with dark narrow pupil, delicate pale-gold details. NO brown flesh, dark sphere, mouth, humanoid limbs, legs, wings, weapons, staff, robes or new objects. All tendrils and eyes are attached to the body as one connected complete silhouette. Do not reproduce stray neighboring artwork or corrupted border pixels from the reference.

LAYOUT IS STRICT: exactly EIGHT equal columns by FIVE equal rows = FORTY complete small separately articulated full-body poses. Large landscape canvas; each entire silhouette INCLUDING all curling tendrils must occupy no more than 40 to 45 percent of BOTH its cell width and its cell height. Center each small figure in its cell with HUGE fully transparent gutters and huge safe image margins. Every figure is disconnected from all neighbors; no silhouette or crop rectangle overlaps another cell. No clipping, missing tendrils, detached particles, floor, shadow, text, labels, panel borders, aura or colored background. All empty areas fully alpha 0. NW/NE are actual rear anatomy, not front faces. Side views show the large central eye EDGE ON and body depth, not a full frontal eye pasted sideways. Make all eight headings unambiguous.

FIVE PHASE ROWS TOP TO BOTTOM: row 1 relaxed IDLE with attached tendrils loosely curled; row 2 distinct breathing IDLE with organically lifted crown, slightly compressed mantle and clearly differently curling tendrils; row 3 movement phase A leaning gently into the travel heading, front-reaching tendrils extended and rear tendrils trailing; row 4 movement passing phase B body settles slightly and tendrils curl inward with different joint arcs; row 5 movement phase C opposite rhythmic sway, formerly trailing tendrils sweep forward while the other curls trail. This species is already floating in the source: preserve its intrinsic organic floating locomotion, NEVER add legs or invent new levitation accessories. Every motion is genuine newly drawn articulation with visibly different body lean and tendril curvature, not scaled, translated or repeated stills. Keep roughly the same vertical body extent and lower tip position within each cell while showing the organic changes. Keep all original eyes attached and preserve a substantial solid central body. Forty complete poses, all connected, no fragments.

All original tendrils are limp and draped sideways on ground, still attached, full body intact. Central eye fully closed on front/side views. Maintain original body mass/detail and correct column heading, keep total width within cell.

All40 frames are genuinely separate newly drawn articulated poses, with clear recoil and physical collapse.
